title: Process CPU parsing
responsibility: Parses process-list rows into CPU totals and recognized application roles without returning command arguments.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.value
inputs.description: Process-list text whose rows contain pid, parent pid, cumulative CPU time and command. Malformed rows are skipped; time may include a day prefix and fractional seconds.

inputs.name: cpuProcesses.monitorPid
inputs.description: Pid to classify as Harness regardless of its command; defaults to the current process id.

outputs.name: cpuProcesses
outputs.description: Parsed processes with numeric pids and CPU milliseconds, plus an optional Codex, Harness or agent role and safe label. Command strings are used only for classification and are not returned.
